title: Bounded Source Diff and Direct Citation Review

requirements.summary: Compare one immutable source with one current tracked live file and expose one-character changes.
Compare two immutable source snapshots without a live path.
List direct citation candidates; claim completeness only for one has_more=false query and label multi-call pagination potentially incomplete.
Preserve scope, sensitive-content, path ambiguity, file type, and race safety.
Bound diff inputs, computation, and Agent-facing output.
Keep review read-only and backward compatible without schema change.
Use TDD and update bilingual docs and using-lwc with local-only Skill validation.
Prove feature performance and absence of regressions on the exact frozen release candidate with retained uncommitted datasets.

assumptions.summary: 8 MiB and 200000 lines cover the first Agent text-review workload.
20000 default and 100000 maximum output characters are sufficient for v0.6.
assumptions.validation: TEST-018, TEST-019 and retained benchmark review

assumptions.summary: similar 3.1.1 is compatible with every supported release target.
assumptions.validation: locked local checks and six-target TEST-031

risks.summary: Pathological inputs can consume CPU or memory.
risks.mitigation: fixed input, line, deadline, output and benchmark caps

risks.summary: Shared live-read refactor can regress status.
risks.mitigation: hash-only status mode plus retained freshness suite
require complete valid difference only when untruncated; truncated output is explicitly a preview

risks.summary: Truncated output can be mistaken for complete.
risks.mitigation: exact counts, explicit flag, Skill warning

risks.summary: Direct refs can be misrepresented as semantic impact.
risks.mitigation: separate command, terminology and negative tests

risks.summary: New dependency can break a target.
risks.mitigation: locked checks and six-target release gate

risks.summary: Citation rows can change between offset-paginated CLI calls.
risks.mitigation: prefer one <=1000-row query; otherwise label the observed de-duplicated scan non-atomic and potentially incomplete

risks.summary: A retained runner can silently benchmark an old hard-coded candidate binary.
risks.mitigation: freeze candidate commit and use a matrix wrapper to verify executable and runner SHA-256 values before and after every child

decisions.summary: Use existing source refs separately; no combined source review response.
Use similar 3.1.1 rather than shelling out or implementing a diff algorithm.
Require exact path only when old source has multiple tracked paths.
Use fixed line Myers, three context lines, and one-second deadline.
No schema, cache, semantic impact, automatic write, or hunk pagination in v0.6.
Scan live diff content for secrets and require explicit sensitive acknowledgement.
Only one has_more=false refs query is complete; multi-call pagination remains an explicitly incomplete observation.
Freeze and commit v0.6.0 before the final matrix; any later tracked edit invalidates all final evidence.
Keep the failed v0.6.0 tag immutable, correct the Windows-only test expectation, and ship the rerun candidate as v0.6.1.
Keep the failed v0.6.1 tag immutable and publish the exact validated tag annotation via notes-file in v0.6.2.

next_action: Create the focused v0.6.2 corrective candidate commit, build that exact HEAD, and rerun the complete checksum-bound local benchmark matrix without further tracked edits.
